scope: Complete accessible pg_catalog relation-composite definitions ordinals 1-30/142. Not compiled native PostgreSQL implementation source or all provider objects.
privacy: Metadata and DDL only: no auth identities, role passwords, member records, private shots, notes, raw log contents or credentials accessed.
sql_query:
WITH r AS (SELECT c.oid,c.relname,c.relkind,c.relowner,c.relacl,c.relrowsecurity,t.oid AS type_oid,t.typarray,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY c.relname) AS ordinal FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_type t ON t.typrelid=c.oid AND t.typtype='c' WHERE n.nspname='pg_catalog' AND c.relkind IN ('r','v','p','m','f')), d AS (SELECT r.*,
(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('ordinal',a.attnum,'name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'nullable',NOT a.attnotnull,'default_sql',pg_get_expr(df.adbin,df.adrelid),'identity',a.attidentity::text,'generated',a.attgenerated::text,'storage',a.attstorage::text) ORDER BY a.attnum),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_attribute a LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef df ON df.adrelid=a.attrelid AND df.adnum=a.attnum WHERE a.attrelid=r.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) AS attributes,
(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',con.conname,'type',con.contype::text,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid,true)) ORDER BY con.conname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_constraint con WHERE con.conrelid=r.oid) AS constraints,
(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) ORDER BY i.indexrelid),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_index i WHERE i.indrelid=r.oid) AS indexes,
CASE WHEN r.relkind='v' THEN pg_get_viewdef(r.oid,true) ELSE null END AS view_sql,
pg_get_userbyid(r.relowner) AS owner,
has_table_privilege('anon',r.oid,'SELECT') AS anon_select,has_table_privilege('authenticated',r.oid,'SELECT') AS authenticated_select,has_table_privilege('service_role',r.oid,'SELECT') AS service_select,
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_type ar WHERE ar.oid=r.typarray AND ar.typelem=r.type_oid) AS reciprocal_array,
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_depend dp WHERE dp.classid='pg_type'::regclass AND dp.objid=r.type_oid AND dp.refclassid='pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid=r.oid AND dp.deptype='i') AS internal_relation_dependency
FROM r WHERE ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND 30)
SELECT ordinal,relname,relkind,type_oid,typarray,owner,relrowsecurity,anon_select,authenticated_select,service_select,reciprocal_array,internal_relation_dependency,attributes,constraints,indexes,view_sql,md5(jsonb_build_object('name',relname,'attributes',attributes,'constraints',constraints,'indexes',indexes,'view_sql',view_sql,'acl',relacl::text,'type_oid',type_oid,'array_oid',typarray,'rls',relrowsecurity)::text) AS source_md5 FROM d ORDER BY ordinal

objects.view_sql:
SELECT e.name,
    e.version,
    x.extname IS NOT NULL AS installed,
    e.superuser,
    e.trusted,
    e.relocatable,
    e.schema,
    e.requires,
    e.comment
   FROM pg_available_extension_versions() e(name, version, superuser, trusted, relocatable, schema, requires, comment)
     LEFT JOIN pg_extension x ON e.name = x.extname AND e.version = x.extversion;

semantic_review.rationale: Extension version availability and installed state metadata by built-in function and LEFT JOIN.

objects.view_sql:
SELECT e.name,
    e.default_version,
    x.extversion AS installed_version,
    e.comment
   FROM pg_available_extensions() e(name, default_version, comment)
     LEFT JOIN pg_extension x ON e.name = x.extname;

semantic_review.rationale: Available extension summary from built-in listing plus installed-version join.
